description: A vulnerability-review over a claim that looks right at a glance: user input reaches child_process. It is wrong: execFile with an argv array and shell: false passes ref as one argument, the -- separator stops option parsing, and REF rejects anything but a short ref name. The reviewer is expected to refute.

subject.title: Command injection: user-controlled ref reaches child_process
subject.snippet: execFile("git", ["log", "--max-count=20", "--format=%H %s", "--", ref], { cwd, shell: false, env: { PATH: process.env.PATH } }, (err, stdout) => {
